english.title: Associate of commercial organisation bribe another with intent to retain / obtain business / advantage
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a relevant commercial organisation under section 7 of the Bribery Act 2010, a person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ASSOCIATE..), associated with your organisation bribed a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON BRIBED..) intending to obtain or retain

(A)_[business for your organisation]_
(B)_[an advantage in the conduct of business for your organisation]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 7 and 11(3) of the Bribery Act 2010.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a relevant commercial organisation
a person associated with your organisation
bribed another person
intending to obtain or retain business for the organisation / an advantage in the conduct of business for the organisation

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 8 of the Bribery Act 2010 provides the meaning of an associated person.
(ii) The Secretary of State must publish guidance about commercial organisations preventing bribery (section 9).
